# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v1.2.0

This is the current public baseline for the local-first BTicino C300X Home
Assistant custom integration. It packages the Home Assistant integration, the
native C300X device agent `1.2.0`, bundled Lovelace cards and the device-side
setup needed for local media features.

## Included

- Local on-demand doorstation video with audio and optional talkback.
- Local Ring Call handling with preview, answer, hang-up and browser/mobile
  dashboard controls.
- Local Home Call support.
- Bundled Doorstation and Home Call Lovelace cards.
- Device-agent update, diagnostics, self-test, media safety watchdogs and
  guided repair flows.
- Optional Ring Call capture and local analysis helper services.

## Upgrade Notes

- Update through HACS, then restart Home Assistant.
- After Home Assistant is back, update the native C300X device agent from the
  integration repair/update flow before testing media features.
- Hard-reload the browser or Home Assistant mobile app WebView if a dashboard
  still shows an old card version.
- Browser/mobile microphone talkback requires HTTPS or another browser-trusted
  secure context.
- If you are upgrading from older test builds and media behaves inconsistently,
  remove the old device agent from the integration and install the bundled agent
  again.
